newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux chief says Q1 tough.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux chief says Q1 tough.

text.p: Appliance maker Electrolux Managing Director Leif Johansson said on Tuesday market conditions in Europe had been very tough in the first quarter of 1997 and the European white goods market had shrunk 3.0 percent in the period.
"I can state that so far this year we have faced a very difficult market situation in Europe, with lower demand in almost all product areas," he said.

"The North American market has however been more stable but with a slight fall in demand for white goods compared with the first quarter of last year," he added. Johansson is leaving Electrolux to take over at carmaker Volvo.
